# IRJET - International Research Journal of Engineering and Technology

> > ISO 9001:2008 certified, peer-reviewed open-access journal publishing multidisciplinary engineering and technology research with fast-track publication options.

IRJET is an international academic publishing platform indexed by Google Scholar, SJIF, and other citation databases, offering researchers a venue for publishing engineering and technology research papers. The journal maintains academic standards through peer review while providing open-access distribution through platforms like academia.edu, Scribd, and Slideshare.
